## WibWob-DOS — Remote Agent Cheatsheet

Base URL: https://wibwob-dos.fly.dev

### Discovery
curl -s $BASE/help | jq .endpoints[].path
curl -s $BASE/openapi.json
curl -s $BASE/commands/list | jq ".[].id"

### Read State
curl -s $BASE/health
curl -s $BASE/state | jq .windows
curl -s $BASE/screenshot/text
curl -s "$BASE/windows/text?id=N"

### Open Things
curl -X POST $BASE/view/figlet/open-default -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"text\":\"HI\"}"
curl -X POST $BASE/view/primer/open -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"filePath\":\"/app/microapps/primer/examples/cave.txt\"}"
curl -X POST $BASE/view/editor/open -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"title\":\"Notes\",\"initial\":\"write here\"}"
curl -X POST $BASE/view/agent/open

### Arrange Windows
curl -X POST $BASE/windows/batch -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"ops\":[{\"id\":1,\"left\":0,\"top\":0,\"width\":80,\"height\":40}]}"

### Run Any Command
curl -X POST $BASE/commands/run -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"id\":\"theme.cycle\"}"
